super_gsd_rules.token_efficiency: No intro. No recap. No preamble. Code + verify only. Report: FILES_CHANGED | VERIFICATION | DEVIATIONS | BLOCKERS | SCRIPTS_CREATED | ONE_LINER Max 300 words total. Structured sections, not prose. Read only file sections you need (use offset/limit). Grep not cat. Glob not find.
super_gsd_rules.relevant_decisions: {RELEVANT_DECISIONS} Follow these decisions. Do not contradict them without flagging as DEVIATION.
super_gsd_rules.relevant_patterns: {RELEVANT_PATTERNS} Apply these patterns where relevant. They are proven approaches.
super_gsd_rules.error_rules: {ERROR_RULES} Check your work against these rules before reporting. Violations are BLOCKERS.
super_gsd_rules.report_format:
After completing all tasks, report EXACTLY:
``` FILES_CHANGED: - path/to/file.ts (created|modified: brief what)
VERIFICATION: - `command` → exit N ✓|✗
DEVIATIONS: - [Rule N - Type] description - or: none
BLOCKERS: - description - or: none
SCRIPTS_CREATED: - path | purpose: what | interface: signature - or: none
ONE_LINER: substantive summary of what was built ```
Do NOT exceed 300 words. Cut DEVIATIONS detail first if over budget. NEVER cut FILES_CHANGED or ONE_LINER.
